editorial_note: Replaced 1,035 Scripture section-heading/book-location questions with original questions on the twelve Bible Character Studies and their supporting Scripture accounts in the supplied Thompson EPUB. References were checked against that EPUB; this is not independent editorial verification. Other 565 questions, including all 100 Master questions, are unchanged. Editorial review flags do not affect game eligibility. Source extracts are not shipped. Added answer-key-matched four-choice questions from the two supplied quiz books; unsupported/dependent formats were not forced into four choices. Source citations appear after answering. No source EPUB is shipped.
